Editorial
AUTOMOTIVE LOVE
AT FIRST SIGHT.
There are few vehicles that connect you to the driving experience in
a truly satisfying way. That’s because there are few vehicles that can
deliver on all counts – whether you’re on a snowy excursion with friends,
heading toward soccer practice in muddy conditions, or merely tackling
the thrilling corners of a challenging stretch of secluded tarmac. Real
life is dynamic, unpredictable and exciting – and requires a vehicle that
can respond accordingly. Here’s the perfect answer: the BMW X .
A reimagined, redesigned and reformulated take on BMW’s original
Sports Activity Vehicle,® the BMW X plots a new course for modern-
day adventurers. A rugged and powerful exterior, yet graceful and agile.
An interior that caters to the driver’s needs, yet elegantly designed
with comfort in mind. And of course, a generous helping of horsep ower,
available in two  avors. It’s not enough to simply read about the BMW
X – it’s a vehicle that must be driven to be truly savored. Welcome to
the next generation of driving bliss.
